svg.title: XH crimp: force versus punch height above bottom of stroke
svg.desc: Model family from calc/stroke_model.py. Force stays in the tens to a few hundred newtons while the wings curl, and climbs to 0.75-2.4 kN only in the last 0.1-0.2 mm before the bottom of the stroke.

g.text: XH crimp, modelled: where along the stroke the force is needed
Estimate family, not measurement (calc/stroke_model.py). Punch moves left to right; 0 = bottom of stroke.
